title: cinchona peruviana var. micrantha
intro: Cinchona peruviana var. micrantha, commonly known as the Yellow Cinchona or Yellow Peruvian Bark, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. The health benefits of Cinchona peruviana var. micrantha include its use in treating fever and malaria, as it is a rich source of quinine, a natural antimalarial agent. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Cinchona peruviana var. micrantha include alkaloids like quinine, quinidine, and cinchonine, among others.
